title: A Partially Functional Dynamic Structural Equation Model for Multi-Resolution Environmental Data
summary: Understanding the complex relationships between atmospheric pollutant emissions and their multifaceted determinants presents a dual challenge: driving factors operate at fundamentally different temporal resolutions, from continuously monitored meteorological variables to annually reported socio-economic indicators, and their interconnections evolve dynamically over time. To address these challenges, we propose a Partially Functional Dynamic Structural Equation Model (PFDSEM) that coherently integrates functional covariates (e.g., high-frequency meteorological data) and scalar predictors…
